claim_rules.scope: in-sample acquisition on the declared phi/psi/omega role surface; no generalization, geometry, EDCM, external-validity, or privacy claim

workload.text: analyze the evidence and identify the strongest supported inference
compare two explanations and test which one fits the observations
calculate the consequence of the stated assumptions
inspect the data for a contradiction in the proposed account
derive a bounded conclusion from the available facts
classify the pattern using only the supplied evidence
describe how your current state differs from your previous state
identify which of your assumptions shaped this response
report your uncertainty about your own conclusion
examine whether your reasoning remained consistent with your stated role
summarize what you changed in your internal approach
distinguish what you know from what you inferred about yourself
choose the next action and commit to one bounded step
decide whether to proceed or stop under the stated constraint
select one option and execute it without requesting another preference
set the stopping point and act within the available authority
resolve the branch by taking the smallest decisive action
make an independent choice while preserving the declared boundaries
